content.text: {"answers": [{"question_id": "Q1", "question": "What specific conditions, severity thresholds, or detection sources cause an event to be formally classified as a defect that initiates this triage workflow?", "answer": "The workflow is initiated when an issue owner registers a defect with initial evidence, including a defect description, sample or lot context, and a customer impact assumption. Specific severity thresholds or detection source criteria are not specified in the workflow definition."}, {"question_id": "Q2", "question": "Which roles or teams are required to participate in the discussion step, and who holds the authority to approve moving the defect to the experimentation phase?", "answer": "After registration, the quality engineer classifies severity and scope, the issue owner notifies related teams and assigns owners, and the process engineer defines root-cause hypotheses before planning experiments. Explicit approval authority to move to experimentation is not specified; the flow proceeds from hypothesis definition directly to experiment planning."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "What types of experiments are performed, and what evidence or outcome criteria must be met before the experimentation step is considered complete?", "answer": "The process engineer plans and runs follow-up experiments logged in an experiment log. Completion is evaluated by whether results support or refute the root-cause hypothesis. Specific experiment types or quantitative outcome criteria required for closure are not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "What decision criteria or evaluation framework is used to select an improvement action from the experimental results, and are there predefined categories of improvement options?", "answer": "The issue owner reviews experiment results and selects an improvement action based on whether the experiment supports the root-cause hypothesis. If supported, an improvement action is chosen; if not, the hypothesis is revisited. Predefined categories of improvement options are not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q5", "question": "Who are the intended recipients of the risk communication, and is there a required format or mandatory content structure for that report?", "answer": "The manager shares the final report and action items as the last step. The customer interface owner assesses customer risk beforehand. A risk report template is listed as a system used. Specific mandatory content structure or explicit recipient list beyond these roles is not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q6", "question": "Are there defined time limits or service-level targets for each stage of the triage process, and what formally marks a defect case as resolved or closed?", "answer": "Time limits and service-level targets per stage are not specified. Experiment delay is noted as a recognized exception. The workflow concludes when the manager shares the final report and action items, which implicitly marks closure, but a formal closure criterion is not explicitly defined."}]}
